description: This file defines a StatusUpdater class and related functions for managing and validating the status and quantities of various document types in an ERP system, including logic for over-delivery and over-billing allowances.

classes.name: OverAllowanceError
classes.description: Custom exception for over allowance limit violations.

classes.name: StatusUpdater
classes.description: Class responsible for updating and validating the status and quantities of documents, including handling over-delivery and over-billing allowances.

methods.name: validate_status
methods.description: Validates if a given status is within allowed options.

methods.name: get_allowance_for
methods.description: Retrieves the allowance value for an item, considering global settings if not specified at item level.
